children: Morningstar provided investor Q&A through Sept. 4, 2026, reaffirming its capital-allocation priorities and board refresh approach.
Filed Investor Q&A as Exhibit 99.1, furnished (not filed), covering questions received through Sept. 4, 2026.
Says it continuously evaluates M&A, may build/partner/acquire when strategic and financial criteria are met; no comment on specific deals.
Reaffirms capital-allocation focus: preserve strong balance sheet, invest in organic growth, pursue accretive acquisitions, grow dividend, repurchase shares opportunistically.
Board refreshment is ongoing: Nominating committee regularly reviews composition; five new directors added since 2017 and mandatory retirement policy (age 73) applied.
